items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: Tony Fougerat, Mutt Powers, Fliver Ford, and J.B. Landry and myself were playing across the river in Plaquemine in a professional gambling place.

ctx.x: Yeah. So everybody called him Fliver. One of the funniest characters that I ever knew in my life. He was a constant laugh. Died very young, dropped dead. J.B. Landry was in the band. Freddie, some played banjo.

items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-08-01
items.q: That's the unit that left the Sanger Theater with my wife in it and the unit that I played for. ... And J.B. I don't know if he's still alive.

ctx.x: I was 24 years old. J.B. Landry.
